description: One folder of one address, newest first, a conversation per row — where `list_threads` says which conversations exist, this says where they are filed and what they look like in a list. `sent` is the way to read what this address sent, from any client, with `to` on each row. Spam is never in `inbox`: the inbox page carries `held_back.spam`, the unread messages filed there, so an empty inbox with spam above zero means read `spam` next. The response carries a `sync_cursor`: hand it to `list_changes` to be told what moved instead of reading the folder again.
name: list_folder
title: What is in a folder
